candidates.instruction: Replace the 32-bit counter with an 8-bit counter and replace the terminal-count branch and `counter + 1` update with explicit toggle equations: bit 0 toggles every enabled cycle, and each higher bit toggles when all lower bits are one. Preserve synchronous reset of the counter and `pwm_out`, and keep the registered comparison `pwm_out <= (counter < duty)` using the pre-update counter value. This is a new RTL coding pattern, but the behavior is still modulo-256 counting; retain it only if all gates pass and routed LUT use is strictly below 7.
